dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 25, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Power Surge: Multiple Home Runs Highlight MLB Action"

The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Chicago Cubs 2-1 behind a strong outing from Ben Brown, who struck out 7 in 6 innings. Michael Busch's 1-run homer was the difference-maker, while teammate Henry Davis added to his league-leading home run total with a solo shot. 

In a high-scoring affair, the Baltimore Orioles topped the Tampa Bay Rays 9-7 behind a 2-run homer from Colton Cowser. Jonathan Aranda also went yard for the Orioles, while Chandler Simpson and Richie Palacios each contributed with multi-hit performances.

The Chicago White Sox shut down the Minnesota Twins 3-1, with Drew Romo's 2-run homer and Anthony Kay's 5 strikeouts leading the way. Anthony Kay also earned the win after 6 strong innings.

The Milwaukee Brewers dominated the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1, with Jacob Misiorowski tossing a 7-inning gem, striking out 12 and allowing just 2 hits. Christian Yelich also homered for the Brewers, while Andrew Vaughn added a key ground-rule double.

The New York Yankees edged the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in a tightly contested matchup, with Cody Bellinger's solo homer providing the winning margin. Michael Wacha pitched 7 strong innings for the Yankees, striking out 5.

The Cincinnati Reds cruised to a 7-2 win over the New York Mets, with Tyler Stephenson's 2-run homer leading the charge. Nick Lodolo also excelled on the mound, striking out 7 in 6 innings.

The Arizona Diamondbacks beat the San Francisco Giants 6-2 behind a 2-run single from Ketel Marte. Landen Roupp struck out 7 in 5 innings for the Diamondbacks, while Merrill Kelly earned the win.

The Washington Nationals routed the Cleveland Guardians 10-2, with Curtis Mead's 2-run homer among the highlights. Logan Allen struck out 7 in 4 innings for the Nationals, while Zack Littell earned the win.

The Philadelphia Phillies blanked the San Diego Padres 3-0, with Brandon Marsh's 2-run homer providing the offense. Jesús Luzardo pitched 6 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 6.

The Houston Astros shut out the Texas Rangers 9-0, with Christian Walker's 3-run homer leading the charge. Tatsuya Imai pitched 6 scoreless innings for the Astros, allowing just 0 hits.

The Miami Marlins beat the Toronto Blue Jays 8-2 behind a 2-run single from Owen Caissie. Janson Junk earned the win for the Marlins, while Lake Bachar struck out 3 in 1.1 innings.

The Los Angeles Dodgers topped the Colorado Rockies 5-3, with Ezequiel Tovar's 2-run homer among the highlights. Emmet Sheehan struck out 8 in 6 innings for the Rockies, while Kyle Hurt earned the win.

The Seattle Mariners beat the Athletics 9-2 behind a 3-run homer from Randy Arozarena. Luis Castillo pitched 4 scoreless innings for the Mariners, striking out 6.
